title: devwork · the decision graph of a plan — the fenced ```yaml graph block inside tasks/<id>/plan.md (spec-kit plan template), or a legacy plan.yml read through yq '{tasks, risks, hypothesis}'.
description: Extracted 2026-09-30 from the plans that shipped: ticket-1437 and ticket-2417 plan.yml (proof_cmd per node, blocks_on_fail, dispatch, hypothesis/falsified_if, RK risks), the worker-runtime74 plan-b queue (phase, phase_gate, 50/50 closed) and ticket-1435 (control, on_fail, ship). Lessons of the 25-plan audit: every node carries a proof_cmd that can fail; no status field, because every written status went stale — state comes from logbook.jsonl and a re-run of the proofs; 15 nodes at most, split the task beyond that. Cross-node rules (ids unique, depends_on resolves, no cycle) are checked by bin/plan-graph, not here.

kind.description: a research node and a change set never share a node (mfg plan.yml, 2026-09-24)

done_when.description: the pass condition, with file:line where a fact decides it

proof_cmd.description: one shell command that exits non-zero when done_when is false; assert a durable output, never the working tree

control.description: what must make this node fail; a check that cannot fail is not a check

gate.description: the owner decides before any dependant runs; a string names who decides and how

effort.description: --effort of the Obra run; copied into mission-T<n>.md with tier as model

advisor.description: --advisor model, only on a node that needs one (ticket-1441 logbook 42)
